data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py` covering all 4 cycle_dispatcher.next_action branches + arbiter wiring.

## Tests to add (one per branch + composites)

1. `test_pass_branch_exits_zero`: next_action returns {action: 'PASS'}; assert runner exits 0; assert no arbiter dispatch; assert PR comment posted summarizing zero unresolved findings.
2. `test_dispatch_next_branch_exits_one`: next_action returns {action: 'DISPATCH_NEXT'}; assert runner exits 1 (failure per DDs); assert PR comment includes "Cycle K complete; N findings remain; awaiting next push for cycle K+1".
3. `test_dispatch_arbiter_branch_calls_arbiter`: next_action returns {action: 'DISPATCH_ARBITER'}; mock dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter returning [{ruling:'DROP', finding_index:0, ...}, {ruling:'BLOCK', finding_index:1, ...}]; assert dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter called with findings + diff + defenses + cycle_num + max_cycles + reviewer_breakdown + ledger_history; assert process_rulings called.
4. `test_dispatch_arbiter_block_exits_one`: arbiter returns 1+ BLOCK; assert runner exits 1.
5. `test_dispatch_arbiter_no_block_exits_zero`: arbiter returns only DROP/DEFER; assert runner exits 0.
6. `test_arbiter_pr_comment_posted`: assert `_post_arbiter_comment` called with cycle_num + commit_sha + rulings; assert marker `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>`; assert idempotency (UPDATE on re-run, not duplicate).
7. `test_short_circuit_reads_prior_arbiter_rulings`: cycle 2 re-run on same SHA with existing arbiter-rulings.json; assert runner reads sidecar; assert exit code matches prior BLOCK presence; assert no LLM dispatch.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock cycle_dispatcher.next_action, dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter, arbiter_processor.process_rulings, and gh CLI. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (exit codes, function call arguments, PR comment content).

## Acceptance

All 7 tests fail on current main: cycle_dispatcher.next_action is not called from runner.py, arbiter dispatch is not wired.

## File Impact

- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py (new, ~280 lines)
